charcoal-briquette.name: Charcoal Briquette
charcoal-briquette.shortDesc: Dense coconut charcoal briquette with high calorific value and low ash, ideal for shisha, BBQ, and industrial fuel needs.
description: Our Charcoal Briquette is made from selected coconut shell charcoal powder compressed without harmful chemicals, producing fuel with a stable flame, high heat, and minimal smoke.
Available in a variety of shapes (cube, hexagonal, pillow, finger, flat) to suit market needs, from household use and BBQ restaurants to shisha lounges across the globe.

coconut-shell-charcoal.name: Coconut Shell Charcoal
coconut-shell-charcoal.shortDesc: Raw coconut shell charcoal carbonized from selected shells — the primary raw material for briquettes and activated carbon.
description: Coconut Shell Charcoal is produced by carbonizing selected coconut shells through a controlled burning process, resulting in charcoal with high fixed carbon and low ash content.
This product is widely used as raw material for briquette manufacturing, activated carbon production, and as a direct industrial fuel source.

semi-husked-coconut.name: Semi Husked Coconut
semi-husked-coconut.shortDesc: Fresh mature coconuts partially husked for easier handling and opening at the destination, while keeping the water and flesh fresh.
description: Semi Husked Coconut is a selected mature coconut with the husk partially removed, leaving a section at the base as a handle and protection during long-distance shipping.
Our harvesting and post-harvest handling process is designed to preserve the freshness of the coconut water and flesh until it reaches the buyer or end consumer.
applications: Raw material for coconut milk/VCO processing
Fresh young and mature coconut export
